work.description: Brief LIV names Archbishop Antonio Mussabini of Smyrna apostolic visitor of the Italo-Greeks of the Two Sicilies; mandate and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF13405–13405; the source dating clause at LF13465–13468 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia novemb. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
